events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
At 937 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm near
Red Lodge, moving southeast at 30 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 40 mph and pea size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor damage to outdoor objects is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Red Lodge, Bearcreek, Washoe and Belfry.

events.region: Lac qui Parle, MN; Stevens, MN; Swift, MN
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
SVRMPX

The National Weather Service in the Twin Cities has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Northwestern Lac qui Parle County in west central Minnesota...
Stevens County in west central Minnesota...
Western Swift County in west central Minnesota...

* Until 1130 PM CDT.

* At 1033 PM CDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line from
25 miles northwest of Chokio to 10 miles northwest of Bellingham,
or along a line from 36 miles west of Morris to 34 miles southwest
of Morris, moving east at 35 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and small hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Big Stone National Wildlife Refuge, Bellingham, Chokio, Louisburg,
Fish Lake, Lake Hattie, Alberta, Donnelly, Appleton, Morris
Airport, Lake Oliver, Morris, Appleton Airport and Holloway.
